grain: one observation per calendar month for the aggregate industry in Victoria
source_release_date_note: Linked ABS March 2025 release is dated 2025-05-02; exact download dates of user files are unknown.
source_table: Retail Trade table 11, state by industry subgroup (original)
extraction: Selected A3349414R only; metadata skipped explicitly; decimal comma parsed in extension; no imputation or deduplication.
assignment_source_anomaly: IA_data.csv has malformed quotation marks in its Sector metadata line and a split 1985-Feb row at physical lines 39-40. The selected value (21.6) is intact before the split; date-matching physical rows were extracted from the first selected columns. The non-date continuation fragment was excluded explicitly. All 488 expected consecutive selected months are preserved and cross-vintage comparison is reported.

schema.month: ISO date, first day of calendar month; unique continuous monthly sequence
schema.turnover_aud_million: strictly positive float, nominal AUD millions

redistribution_note: Only the single public ABS aggregate series is packaged. Student-ID columns and assignment documents are excluded.
vintage_policy: Keep original assignment history for all pre-Dec2022 fitting/validation; evaluate against extension outcomes Dec2022-Mar2025; use full extension snapshot only for dated post-evaluation refit. This is a retrospective experiment, not a verified real-time backtest.
